goal: A single-task run driven with a caller-supplied store persists its complete run record (task version, lifecycle, attempts, events, grader results) through that store and creates no sqlite database.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/workflow.py -- run_task_object builds its own SqliteStore from db_path today; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_protocols.py -- the store protocol the injected object satisfies
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_memory.py -- MemoryStore, the natural injection vehicle for the new test
constraints: The store parameter is optional: a call supplying only db_path behaves byte-for-byte as today, so no existing caller changes in this task
The complete run record flows through the injected store -- task version, lifecycle, every attempt, run events, grader results -- not a terminal subset
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not touch flywheel-orchestrator, flywheel-worktree, flywheel-container, or the flywheel product package -- wiring the orchestrator is a separate task
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A run given an injected store must not create the db_path sqlite file at all -- an implementation that opens both stores must fail the behavior test
Grader results and run events must land in the injected store, not only the final lifecycle row -- a terminal-summary-only write must fail
